info.title: Vulyk API
info.description:
Open-source test management system (beehive). Projects (optional key, case_key_prefix + never-reused PREFIX-N case numbers), nested folder trees with recursive counts, plans/runs, automation executions (campaigns/iterations/pipeline ingest), ALM/importers/reports, LLM generate/chat (propose/create), MCP, locales en/uk/fr/es/de, deploy.

## Auth in /api/docs (Scalar)

1. **Bearer** — open **Auth**, select `bearer_auth`, paste a JWT from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (`token` field) or a personal API token from Settings → Tokens. Scalar sends `Authorization: Bearer …`.
2. **Session cookie** — if you are already signed in on this origin, the browser sends the HttpOnly `vulyk_session` cookie with Test Request automatically (no paste). Cookie auth is not editable in Scalar; use Bearer when calling from another tool.
3. Search uses the sidebar search box (Ctrl/⌘+K). Test Request runs against the same-origin server (`/`).

AbandonRunRequest.description: Admin abandon of a stuck `in_progress` / `running` run.

version.description: Optional explicit target version; defaults to the active rollback point.

password_policy.description: Shared password policy so the UI never drifts from server-side rules.

display_id.description: Human-readable never-reused id from the underlying test run.

slug.description: Canonical URL slug from the underlying test run.

has_actions_token.description: Encrypted Actions write token is set (workflow_dispatch).

last_index_trigger.description: How the last index was triggered: `manual` | `webhook` | `poll`.

poll_interval_minutes.description: Poll interval in minutes; `0` disables polling.

webhook_secret.description: Per-repo webhook shared secret (GitHub HMAC / GitLab token).

webhook_url.description: Absolute webhook URL when `VULYK_BASE_URL` is set; otherwise a path.

has_secrets.description: True when encrypted secrets are stored (never expose ciphertext).

upsert.description:
Deprecated: results are append-only. When true with a matching external_id,
a new history row is still inserted (never overwritten). Kept for API compat.

idempotent_replays.description: Duplicate `(external_id, status)` retries within the same run that were skipped.

seq_number.description: Per-project monotonic sequence (never reused after delete).

plan_type.description: Stable plan kind: `ci`, `iteration`, or `run` (UI localizes the label).

id.description: Built-in id (`key`, `title`, …) or `cf:<uuid>` for a project custom field.

pass_rate.description: Pass rate over decided results (Passed / (Passed + Failed)).

proposal.description: Edited proposal from the preview card.

provider.description: Echo of which model drafted it (for audit).

folder_id.description: Suite id for cases; requirement folder id for requirements.

new_folder_name.description: When set, create this folder (under parent `folder_id`) before inserting.

confirmation_prompt.description: Human-readable confirmation prompt for the UI.

CiConfigPublic.description: API-safe CI config: provider tokens and webhook secrets are redacted.

seed_sample.description: Seed sample projects: Kyiv concert + Vulyk QA (default true).

secrets_passphrase.description: Optional passphrase to encrypt SSO/integration secrets into the bundle.

children.description: Nested folders (recursive). Schema uses Object to avoid OpenAPI recursion blow-up.

encrypted_secrets.description: Secrets are omitted unless encrypted_secrets is set.

children.description: Nested folders (Object in OpenAPI to avoid recursion blow-up).

secret.description: Plaintext token — shown once; store it as `VULYK_API_TOKEN`.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded file body (kept small for Phase 1; object storage later).

actions_token.description: GitHub Actions write token (workflow_dispatch); encrypted at rest.

poll_interval_minutes.description: Poll interval minutes; omit for default 15; `0` disables.

secrets.description: Plaintext secrets object (token, app_password, service_account_json, …). Encrypted at rest.

external_key.description: Original external identifier from an import (stored separately from the Vulyk key).

key.description: Ignored when present — keys are allocated automatically. Kept optional for API compat.

CreateCustomField.description: Legacy create body kept for project-scoped API compatibility.

project_ids.description: Required when scope = selected; ignored when scope = all.

case_ids.description: Optional case ids to assign into the iteration.

suite_ids.description: Optional suite ids — all cases in those suites are assigned.

global.description: When true, store as a global config (`project_id IS NULL`) available to all projects.

case_key_prefix.description: Optional override for case key prefix (must be unique). Derived from name when omitted.

key.description:
Uppercase project key, e.g. DEMO. Derived from `name` (same initials rules as
`case_key_prefix`) when omitted.

include_all_cases.description: When true, include every project case if no other selectors are set.

start.description: Start the run immediately (status=in_progress) when creating with items.

status.description: MCP/CLI-compatible initial status (default draft; ignored when `start` is true).

options.description: Legacy alias: options array derived from option list items when present.

in_use.description: True when stored values exist; hard-delete should be blocked.

DeleteSuiteQuery.description: Options when deleting a non-empty folder.

on_nonempty.description:
`move_to_parent` (default) reparents cases/children to the deleted folder's parent.
`delete_cases` deletes cases in this folder (and descendants) and retires their keys.

run_id.description: Optional Vulyk run to attach; created automatically when omitted.

children.description: Nested campaign/iteration nodes (schema flattened to avoid recursive OpenAPI).

FieldMapping.description: Field mapping from source columns/keys to Vulyk case fields.

custom_fields.description: Map of Vulyk custom field key → source column/key.

persist.description: When true, persist generated drafts as cases (still reviewable).

requirements_text.description: Free-text requirements (used when requirement_ids is empty).

repo_id.description: When the project has multiple automation repos, select which to index.

context_files.description: Repo files included in the LLM prompt (empty when no automation repo).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field definition key.

content.description: Raw file contents (UTF-8 text or base64 for binary — Phase 1 expects UTF-8).

dry_run.description: When true, only return preview without persisting.

async_mode.description: When true (or payload is large), enqueue a background job.

content.description: Raw payload (XML or JSON text). Prefer multipart/file via CLI for large bodies.

created_by_name.description: Optional CI actor / bot display name (stored on the run when provided).

IngestResultItem.description: Legacy/simple bulk item used by MCP-friendly `POST .../results`.

ci_allow_private_urls.description:
Admin opt-in: allow plain HTTP and private/LAN/localhost CI destinations.
Off by default. Prefer a non-empty [`Self::ci_url_allowlist`] in production.
(Avoid scheme literals here — OpenAPI is inlined into /api/docs HTML.)

ci_url_allowlist.description:
Optional hosts / CIDRs that may use the private CI opt-in.
Empty + opt-in = any private/localhost; non-empty = only these entries
(public HTTPS remotes remain allowed either way).

default_theme.description: Default appearance theme for users who have not chosen one.

seq_number.description: Per-project monotonic sequence (never reused after delete).

ListBranchesBody.description: List branches from unsaved form values.

campaign.description: Campaign / iteration names (auto-create when ids omitted).

planned_total.description:
Expected case/result count (e.g. Playwright suite size). Stored in
`test_runs.meta.planned_total` so live progress can use a stable total.

start.description: When true, create as `in_progress` instead of `open`.

idempotent.description: True when an existing run was returned for the same `external_ref`.

display_id.description: Human-readable never-reused id from the underlying test run.

slug.description: Canonical URL slug from the underlying test run.

custom_fields.description: Populated on list when fields have `show_in_list`; empty otherwise.

automated.description:
True when the case has an `external_key` (automation / import link)
**or** `last_automation_at` (CI/ingest has posted results).

seq_number.description: Per-project monotonic sequence (never reused after delete).

campaign.description: Campaign name (created if missing). Defaults to "CI".

created_by_name.description: CI bot / token / actor name shown in the suites table.

iteration.description: Iteration name (created if missing). Defaults to pipeline/ref name.

run_name.description: Display name for the automated suite / run.

case_key_prefix.description: Auto-derived uppercase initials used for case keys (e.g. KOC).

next_case_number.description: Monotonic counter; next allocated case uses this+1. Never decreases.

case_index.description: Index into the proposed cases list.

requirement_index.description: Index into the proposed requirements list (same proposal or 0 if only cases).

custom_fields.description: Populated on get; empty on list responses.

locale.description: Locale for seeded strings (defaults to instance default).

oneOf.description: Inline archive (JSON ContentArchive). For ZIP uploads use multipart endpoint.

new_project_key.description: Optional new key when mode=new_project and key would clash.

run_id.description: When set, load archive bytes from this completed backup run.

target_project_id.description: Target project for merge/replace. Ignored for new_project (uses archive key, may rename).

RoleMatrixRow.description: Static matrix rows for docs / OpenAPI / admin UI.

RunCaseResultRow.description: One case row in a run report (paginated).

RunInCiRequest.description: Trigger a GitHub workflow_dispatch for selected cases / a prior suite.

case_ids.description: Case UUIDs to include (keys resolved server-side).

case_keys.description: Explicit case keys (merged with resolved ids).

repo_id.description: Automation repo that holds the Actions write token + workflow settings.

source_run_id.description: Re-run cases from an existing suite/run.

RunReportDetail.description: Detailed run header for the reports drill-down view.

SampleDataSummary.description: Counts of sample rows currently in the database (for admin UI / remove response).

case_count.description: Recursive total: this folder + all descendant folders.

direct_case_count.description: Cases whose `suite_id` is exactly this folder (no descendants).

TestAutomationRepoBody.description: Probe connectivity from unsaved form values (no repo id required).

project_ids.description: Optional projects used for RBAC when auth is required.

custom_fields.description: Populated on list when fields have `show_in_list`; empty otherwise.

automated.description:
True when the case has an `external_key` (automation / import link)
**or** `last_automation_at` (CI/ingest has posted results).

custom_fields.description: Values for requested custom-field columns (`cf_ids` query param).

last_run_status.description:
Latest `test_results.status` by executed_at (manual + ingest).
Served from denormalized `test_cases.last_run_status` (review #11).

case_version.description: Case version at the time of execution.

executed_by.description: User who recorded this result (nullable for anonymous / CI ingest).

TestResultHistoryItem.description: A result row enriched for history timelines (run name, executor, counts).

is_sample.description: Seeded demo run (admin sample-data remove targets these).

seq_number.description: Per-project monotonic sequence (never reused after delete).

actions_token.description: Omit to leave unchanged; empty string clears.

rotate_webhook_secret.description: When true, rotate the webhook secret.

token.description: Omit to leave unchanged; empty string clears.

secrets.description: When set, replaces stored secrets. Omit to keep existing. Empty object clears.

clear_suite.description: When true, clear suite_id (move case to project root / unfiled).

expected_version.description:
When set, update fails with 409 unless the case is still at this version
(optimistic concurrency / review #7). Omit for last-write-wins clients.

acknowledge_hide_values.description: When true, scope/project changes hide fields but keep stored values.

api_key.description: Set to empty string to clear the stored key.

reduced_motion.description: Pass `null` explicitly to clear override and follow system again.

case_key_prefix.description: Editable only before any cases exist (next_case_number == 0 and no cases/tombstones).

clear_folder.description: Set true to move to root (clear folder).

client_secret.description: When set, encrypt and store; omit to leave unchanged; empty string clears.

clear_parent.description: When true, move folder to project root (parent_id = NULL).

last_check_error_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the last failed check.

last_check_error_code.description: Stable machine code for the last failed check (`git_host_rate_limit`, …).

last_check_error_reset_at.description: RFC3339 rate-limit reset time when known (`x-ratelimit-reset`).

last_checked_at.description:
RFC3339 time of the last check **attempt** (success or failure).

Always advanced on both success and failure so auto-check interval /
backoff can suppress hammering GitHub. Last-good `latest_*` metadata is
kept separately on failure.

font_family.description: UI body font family id (`inter` default). See `FONT_FAMILIES`.

bearer_auth.description: Paste a session JWT (`POST /api/v1/auth/login` → `token`) or a personal API token (Settings → Tokens / `POST /api/v1/tokens`). Alternatively, when browsing /api/docs on this origin while logged in, the HttpOnly `vulyk_session` cookie is sent automatically with Test Request.
